def run(xi,c,delta,K=13):
    x=xi.clone()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for k in range(20):
            t=torch.full((len(c),),1-k/20)
            v,A=net.velocity(x,t,c,capture=("out_act",))
            if delta is not None and k<K:
                m=(A["out_act"]@w+b>0)
                v=v+m[:,None].float()*torch.tensor(delta).float()
            x=x-v/20
    return x.numpy()
